title: 第一卷 第7章 你不是想要龙鳞参老子过来拉给你第一卷 第8章 我要打死你
content_zh:
紫云山有大蜥蜴！
又长又大又凶猛！
会吃人肉喝人血！
自小到大，他每每有了去紫云山深处狩猎的念头，老头子便会拿这个故事吓唬他。
多年来。
他也养成了习惯，从不到这里来。
如今看。
老头子的故事竟然是真的！
真有大蜥蜴！
刚想到这里，一道温热腥臭之气骤然袭来，他余光一扫，见那不知是什么玩意的怪物已然追到了身后十丈！
而且！
还在不断接近！
“砰——！”
“砰——！”
“……”
一人一兽，一逃一追，山石破裂和古木倒塌的声音此起彼伏，也彻底打破了山林中的静谧和幽暗！
眼见自己即将成为对方的口中餐，顾尘头皮虽然麻，却并没有失去冷静。
自小到大。
他打猎之时。
不知道被山中的虎豹追了多少次，次次都能化险为夷，靠的自然不只是运气！

更多的是智慧！
身为紫云村第一猎手，他深谙兽性！
饿了吃，渴了喝，怒了就给它找个发泄的小目标……简单而又纯粹！
瞥了瞥身后的绿光，他心里忽地一动！
后面的大块头明显和寻常野兽不一样，或许想吃的……也不仅仅是寻常血肉？
想到这里，他突然自怀中摸出一颗泛着腥气的血红色丹药，直接扔了过去！
这丹药是从那刀疤汉子身上搜到的，他虽然没敢吃，却也一直留着。
丛林幽暗，丹药不大。
可那妖兽目力极好，眼见丹药飞过来，便下意识一张口，吞了进去。
然后——
突然停住不动了！
嗖的一下！
顾尘趁机拉开了老长一段距离。
只是——
几个呼吸之后，那妖兽再次暴走，又是发出了一声低吼，吼声竟是带着渴望和兴奋，追得更快了！
身后腥风再起！
顾尘心里一跳，听声音就知道对方是没吃饱，还想吃。
“给你！”
又是摸出一颗丹药，又扔了出去。
妖兽再次停住。

抓住机会，顾尘又是拉开了距离。
可——
content_en:
There are big lizards in Ziyun Mountain!
Long, big and fierce!
Can eat human flesh and drink human blood!
Since childhood, every time he had the idea of ​​going hunting deep in Ziyun Mountain, the old man would scare him with this story.
Over the years.
He also made a habit of never coming here.
Look now.
The old man’s story turned out to be true!
There really is a big lizard!
Just when he thought of this, a warm and stinky smell suddenly hit him. With a glance from the corner of his eye, he saw that the unknown monster was already chasing him ten feet behind him!
and!
Still getting closer!
"Bang——!"
"Bang——!"
"..."
One man and one beast, one escaping and the other chasing, the sounds of cracking rocks and falling ancient trees came one after another, completely breaking the silence and darkness in the forest!
Seeing that he was about to become the other person's meal, although Gu Chen's scalp was numb, he did not lose his calmness.
From childhood to adulthood.
While he was hunting.
I don’t know how many times I have been chased by tigers and leopards in the mountains, but I have been able to save myself every time. Of course it’s not just luck!
More wisdom!
As the number one hunter in Ziyun Village, he is well versed in animal nature!
Eat when it's hungry, drink when it's thirsty, and find a small target for it to vent to when it's angry...simple and pure!
Glancing at the green light behind him, his heart suddenly moved!
The big guy at the back is obviously different from ordinary beasts. Maybe he wants to eat... not just ordinary flesh and blood?
Thinking of this, he suddenly took out a blood-red pill with a fishy smell from his arms and threw it directly!
This elixir was found from the scarred man. Although he didn't dare to eat it, he still kept it.
The jungle is dark and the elixir is small.
But the monster's eyesight was very good. When he saw the pill flying over, he subconsciously opened his mouth and swallowed it.
Then——
Suddenly it stopped moving!
Whoosh!
Gu Chen took the opportunity to distance himself from Lao Chang.
Just——
After a few breaths, the monster went berserk again and let out another low roar. The roar was filled with desire and excitement, and it chased even faster!
The fishy wind is rising again!
Gu Chen's heart skipped a beat, and he knew from the voice that the other person was not full and wanted to eat.
"Here you go!"
He took out another pill and threw it out again.
The monster stopped again.
Seizing the opportunity, Gu Chen distanced himself again.
